holdout_policy: exclude any primary v3 train/validation exact/template family or semantic near-template; use final primary artifacts, no retraining
inference: exploratory even if target met; automated contexts are not independent human truth
origin_policy: real_source controls preferred; no synthetic primary; uncertain_origin explicit
sampling: fixed SHA256(42:frame_id) within label, max100 each; no detector outcomes
semantic_similarity: NOT_AVAILABLE no independent embedding model predefined; reviewed semantic_preserved is binary judgment, not numerical similarity
